_note: Addressed by --cone-regions, explicitly, per experiment. --cones N reads the SEPARATE `cone_regions` key and takes `regs[:N]` (drive_english.py), so --cones 1 spawns region 54. Appending a POSE to `cones` therefore does NOT move any count-addressed experiment; only editing `cone_regions` does. Prefer --cone-regions: a count hides WHICH junction is armed, and editing `cone_regions` for one mission silently moves the cones of every count-addressed mission. | 70 and 65 hold corner poses.
